buildCommand: build.bat /s in the branch checkout; the build rewrote the line endings of src/shared/surface/material.js, which was restored afterwards
captureMethod: Playwright _electron launch of the packaged executable with a fresh isolated --user-data-dir profile and a hidden, unfocusable window; window screenshots at device scale factor 1; navigation by pointer clicks on the navigation tree; theme and density set through the Settings controls; English
privacy: Every frame was inspected by eye. Frames that showed a user profile path or a signed-in account name were not published. Pixels were never edited.
notCaptured: An unlocked drive with files, the details pane and versions: the isolated profile has no configured drive and WinFsp mounting was not run.
The Docker Hub backup page: in this profile it showed a signed-in account name, so it was not published.
The drive list at 1440 pixels: its details pane showed a user profile path, so the 1024-pixel frame is published instead.
Bilingual and Cantonese modes of the new pages.
Home and Local tools at 360 pixels: the capture script could not reach them from the closed navigation drawer, so those frames repeated the drive list and were not published.
